name: ESCERAM
recent: 公司于2026年10月28日召开第23届常年股东大会，所有决议案均获股东通过。最新季度（截至2026年8月31日）营收同比增长19.9%，净利同比增长107.8%，但净利环比下降6.6%。此外，一名非执行董事于2024年11月申报了5,000,000股股份的转让。
notable: 第23届常年股东大会于2026年10月28日举行，所有决议案获股东通过。
非执行董事Miss Tan San Li于2024年11月7日转让5,000,000股普通股（占0.707%）。
risks: 非执行董事涉及股份转让，可能引起市场对董事持股变动的关注。
earnings: 截至2026年8月31日季度，营收为143,462,823令吉，同比增长19.9%，环比增长8.2%；净利为4,383,493令吉，同比增长107.8%，环比下降6.6%；净利率为3.1%，低于上一季度的3.5%。

recent_en: The company held its 23rd AGM on 28 Oct 2026, with all resolutions approved by shareholders. For the latest quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, revenue rose 19.9% YoY and net profit jumped 107.8% YoY, while net profit fell 6.6% QoQ. Separately, a Non-Executive Director reported a transfer of 5,000,000 shares in Nov 2024.
notable_en: The 23rd AGM was held on 28 Oct 2026 and all resolutions were approved by shareholders.
Non-Executive Director Miss Tan San Li transferred 5,000,000 ordinary shares (0.707%) on 7 Nov 2024.
risks_en: The share transfer by a Non-Executive Director may draw market attention to changes in director shareholdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, revenue was MYR143,462,823, up 19.9% YoY and 8.2% QoQ; net profit was MYR4,383,493, up 107.8% YoY but down 6.6% QoQ; net margin was 3.1% versus 3.5% in the prior quarter.
